blocks.label: Overview
bullets: American Masters of Taste - Gold Medal Superior Taste
paragraphs: Nutrition You Need, Indulgent Flavors You Want

Enjoying something sweet and delicious shouldn't mean you've lost track of your health and fitness goals. Premier Protein® packs powerful nutrition and amazing flavor into each one of its protein powders.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Mix 2 scoops (provided) of powder into 6-8 oz of water or milk to easily make a delicious Premier Protein® Shake. Or blend with your favorite fruits for a delicious smoothie recipe

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Whey protein isolate, whey protein concentrate, cocoa processed with alkali, contains 2% or less of soluble corn fiber, sunflower lecithin, natural and artificial flavors, acesulfame potassium, sucralose, xanthan gum, salt.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Use this product as a food supplement only. Do not use for weight reduction.
Store in a cool dry place. Keep out of reach of children.
